cover.alt: Auralis Overview page: system chips showing the API online on an Apple M4 GPU with local storage, a warm-up panel with load times for the language model, speech recognition, Kokoro English and Hindi voices, knowledge search, watermark model and speaker check, and totals of 5 voices, 138 generations and 6.0 minutes synthesized

gallery.alt: Auralis home page with the headline Your voice, in eleven languages, and a player listing preset voices in English and Hindi, with the Heart voice's waveform and the line it reads
gallery.caption: The home page plays real, unedited output from the open Kokoro-82M model running in Auralis. Visitors can hear English and Hindi preset voices before they open the studio.

gallery.alt: Clone a voice dialog at step 1 of 3 (Sample, Transcript, Review), with a passage to read aloud in English, Hindi, Hinglish or Marathi, and options to upload an audio file or record
gallery.caption: Cloning starts with a short read-aloud sample. A separate spoken consent sentence with a one-time code is checked against the sample's speaker before the voice can be used.

gallery.alt: Auralis Analytics page with a bar chart of generations by engine (Indic-Speak, Qwen3 0.6B, DhVaani, Kokoro), a language mix led by Hindi, and a line chart of generations per day over the last 7 days
gallery.caption: Analytics counts every generation by engine, language and day. Most of this week's output was Hindi, rendered by the Indian-language engines.
